text: Vishnu Nambiar is an AI engineer and BTech student in AI and ML at CHRIST (Deemed to be University), Bengaluru, graduating in 2027. He builds explainable models, bounded agents and ML pipelines, and tests his claims before making them.

Programming: Python, SQL, TypeScript, JavaScript. ML and AI: PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, OpenCV, NLP, LangChain, generative and agentic AI, explainable AI, time-series forecasting. Data: Pandas, NumPy, MongoDB, Neo4j, Redis, advanced Excel. Engineering: MLOps, Docker, GitHub Actions, MLflow, FastAPI, Flask, REST APIs, Git, pytest. Web and mobile: React, Node.js, Flutter.

Four projects are on this page, each with a live demo: Medical XAI (explainable symptom checker), the Autonomous Engineering Harness (bounded multi-agent coder), the MLOps Agent (Python model to deployable project) and Restaurant Forecasting (revenue and footfall).

Medical XAI ranks 16 conditions from free-text symptoms. Each score blends TF-IDF similarity (60%) with symptom overlap (40%) and is shown as a breakdown. On 15,360 simulated cases the right condition was in the top 3 for 96 to 100% of cases, with p95 latency under 35 ms. These are simulated cases, not clinical validation.

The Autonomous Engineering Harness is a coding pipeline of architect, worker, validator, executor and reviewer roles run as a state machine. A deterministic validator decides whether a diff is valid, and fixed budgets (2 patches, 1 re-plan) stop runaway loops. It has 10 pytest tests that drive the orchestrator with scripted model replies.

The MLOps Agent takes a Python model file and generates a deployable project: FastAPI service, Dockerfile, GitHub Actions and GitLab CI, MLflow hooks, tests and docs. The generated project installs in a clean virtualenv and its 7 tests pass. It generates scaffolds; it does not retrain or version models by itself.

Restaurant Forecasting predicts daily revenue with SARIMA and footfall with random forest and gradient boosting. On a 60-day holdout SARIMA cut error from 17.3% to 11.7% MAPE against a seasonal-naive baseline. Those figures come from synthetic data because the original CSV is not in the repository.

Freelance AI/ML and web developer since April 2025. Intern at Tata Consultancy Services (April to June 2025). Student Head at the CHRIST Incubation and Consulting Foundation (June to December 2024), where he worked on an accessibility-focused Android app in Flutter.
